question: Why can a and b have the same raw-sample hash but different display intensity under C21?

criteria.instruction: Both store 128 but a uses Q, yielding (128/255)^2 about 0.252, while b uses P, yielding 128/255 about 0.502. v14 only relabels Q as P without transforming samples. A raw-sample hash omits interpretation metadata; same bytes do not establish the same complete image.
Join C21's explicit invented transforms, exporter inspection and sample profiles. Distinguish assignment from intensity-preserving conversion.
Do not diagnose monitor failure, corrupted pixel bytes or real color-standard behavior from this synthetic transform.
